report: SAĞ DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Medial menisküs laterale ekstrüde görünümdedir. Medial ve lateral menisküste evre 2 intrameniskal dejenerasyon ile uyumlu sinyal intensite değişiklikleri izlendi. Medial menisküs gövde kesiminde bütünlük kaybı izlenmiş olup bu düzeyde diz eklem mesafesi daralmıştır. Medial menisküs anterior hornunda kök düzeyinde yırtık ile uyumlu sinyal değişiklikleri mevcuttur.Ön çapraz bağ ve arka çapraz bağ, lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir.Retropatellar ve femoral kartilajda kondromalazi ile uyumlu kıkırdak erezyonu ve bu düzeyde subkondral kemik iliği ödemi izlendi.Distal kuadriseps ve diğer patellar tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Eklemde sıvı artışı saptanmamıştır. Diz eklemi oluşturan kemik yapılarda kontüzyonel ödem mevcuttur.

Mediales Kompartiment:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Intakter Knorpel. Intakter Innenmeniskus. Intaktes MCL.

Laterales Kompartiment:
Nicht dislozierte Impressionsfraktur des dorsolateralen Tibiaplateaus mit entsprechendem Bone-bruise ebendort (Serie 7/ Image 21). Keine Beteiligung der intraartikulären Gelenkfläche. Geringes Kontusionsödem in der zentralen Belastungszone der lateralen Femurcondyle. Intakter Knorpel. Intakter Außenmeniskus. Intaktes LCL.

Femoropatellares Gleitlager und Trochlea:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Tiefgreifender Knorpeldefekt an der superomedialen Patellafacette (Serie 8/ Image 13). Kein vollschichtiger Knorpeldefekt, kein subchondrales Knocheödem. Kein Nachweis eines freien Gelenkkörpers. Regelrechte Darstellung der Quadrizeps- und Patellarsehne. Regelrechte Darstellung des Hoffa`schen Fettkörpers.

Kreuzbänder:
Verdacht auf Totalruptur des VKB mit noch einzelnen intakten Fasern. Intaktes HKB.

Muskulatur und übrige Weichteile:
Ausgedehnter Gelenkerguss. Plica mediopatellaris (Typ B nach Sakakibara).

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Pain after bending down 4 weeks ago.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Small, ruptured Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Irregularity of the weightbearing lateral femoral condyle and lateral tibial plateau. Focal full-thickness fissuring at the posterior nonweightbearing lateral femoral condyle with subchondral edema.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Full-thickness cartilage loss of the central trochlea with subchondral edema. Low-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss at the lateral patellar facet with full-thickness fissuring.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 10 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
High-grade lateral and patellofemoral compartment chondrosis.

Femoralseitige Partialläsion des MCL in den anterioren Anteilen DD femoralseitige Läsion des MPFL (Traumamechanismus mit Lateralisation der Patella?). (7/17) Keine Zeichen stattgehabter Patellaluxation.
Bone Bruise in der medialen Femurkondyle und zentral im medialen Tibiaplateau. Gering präpatellares subkutanes Hämatom/diffus Flüsssigkeit. Degenerative Signalveränderungen des Innenmeniskus ohne Rissbildung. Kreuzbänder, Außenmeniskus und laterales Kollateralband intakt. Kein Kniegelenkerguss. Retropatellararthrose mit vollschichtiger fokale Chondropathie am Patellafirst und assoziierter kleiner Zystenbildung sowie tiefergreifende Riefenbildung zentral in der Trochlea. Flächige Knorpelausdünnung im lateralen Kompartiment

ligamenata, prednjeg i stražnjeg križnog ligamenta i iliotibijalnog traktusa.

nalazi se ukopano koštano tijelo dimenzija 12x6 mm - stanje po Osgood-Schlaterovoj bolesti.

(hondromalacija 2. stupnja prema ICRS klasifikaciji).
Fisure i raslojavanje pune debljine hrskavice lateralnog kondila tibije (hondromalacija 3. stupnja
prema ICRS klasifikaciji).
Ostale prikazane artikulacijske hrskavice urednih su intenziteta signala.
Manja količina izljeva u koljenu, manja poplitealna (Bakerova) cista.
Ostale prikazane koštane, mekotkivne i neurovaskularne strukture uredne su morfologije i
intenziteta signala.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: lumbar radiculopathy; bilateral knee pain for 1 year, no injury
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: Mild thinning without focal defect.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: High-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss along the posterior weightbearing lateral tibial plateau. Cartilage thinning along the lateral femoral condyle.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Mild heterogeneity with low-grade fissuring of the medial facet and median ridge.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. Mild lateral patellar tilt and translation. Mild patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Top normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 17 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Tricompartmental chondrosis, most significant in the lateral compartment.
2.	Small knee joint effusion.

There is medial meniscal extrusion at the level of the body, deemed secondary to an undisplaced degenerative type tear through the corresponding posterior horn and root.  
Mildly degenerate but otherwise intact lateral meniscus, normal cruciate and collateral ligaments, popliteus, patellar tendon and distal iliotibial band. Chronic, quiescent looking calcific distal insertional quadriceps tendinopathy is present anteriorly. 
 No fracture or marrow infiltration, minimal intra-articular fluid, probably within normal physiological limits.  Mild age-related thinning of tricompartmental articular cartilage, probably most apparent at the medial weightbearing compartment. Tiny focus of high-grade cartilage loss with associated faint focal reactive marrow changes is noted adjacent to the median ridge of the patella.  Small focus of grade 3 cartilage loss noted at the central portion of the lateral tibial plateau. Grossly unremarkable imaged extra-articular soft tissues.

SAĞ DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Lateral menisküs normaldir.  Medial menisküs diz eklem mesafesinden 5 mm mediale ekstrüdedir. Menisküs hacminde azalma, posterior horn ve gövde kesiminde ise grade III dejenerasyon izlenmiştir.Arka çapraz bağ, lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir. Anterior çapraz bağda miksoid dejenerasyona sekonder sinyal değişikliği izlenmiştir. Gastrocnemius medial krus proksimal insersiyo düzeyinde tendinozis ile uyumlu sinyal değişikliği izlenmiştir. Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur. Patella medial fasette kartilaj bütünlüğü belirgin incelmiştir. Medial retinakulumda da fokal sinyal artışı izlenmiştir. Pes anserin bursasında da sıvı artışı izlenmiştir.Eklemde sıvı artışı saptanmamıştır. Diz eklemini oluşturan kemik yapıların sinyal intensiteleri doğaldır.Tibia femoral eklem düzeyinde kemik yapı köşelerinde osteofitik sivrileşme izlenmiştir. Tibia femoral eklem medialinde eklem aralığında daralma, ekleme komşu tibia medial platoda subkondral alanda milimetrik kist ve ödem izlenmiştir. Bu seviyede femoral ve tibial kartilajlarda destrüksiyon izlenmiştir. Bulgular dejeneratif artrit lehine yorumlanmıştır. Sonuç: Gonartroz, medial menisküste mediale ekstrüzyon, volüm kaybı ve grade III meniskopati, anterior çapraz bağda miksoid dejenerasyon, gastrocnemius medial krus tendinozisi, pes anserin bursiti, patella medial fasette grade III kondromalazi.

Lig. iliotibiale postoperativ zunehmend verdickt von zuletzt 3 auf 6 mm (5/14) über eine Länge von ca. 8 cm im distalen Abschnitt. Die ehemals zwischen lateraler Femurkondyle und Lig. iliotibiale gelegenen Anteile des Ganglions sind regredient; kranial hiervon gelegene Anteile liegen unverändert dem Band an mit fokalem Durchbruch nach lateral (8/22).

Neu zur Voruntersuchung T2 hyperintense Flüssigkeitsansammlung entlang des Randes des medialen Gastrocnemiuskopfes, assoziiert kleine zystoide Läsionen (3/42 und 27) mit 5 und 10 mm, DD Baker-Zyste.

Unauffällige Darstellung femoropatellar und -tibial. Keine Chondropathie. Quadriceps- und Patellarsehne unauffällig. Hoffa'scher Fettkörper ohne Fibrose oder Ödem. Kreuzbänder intakt. DD mukoide Signalalterationen im IMHH. Prox. Tibiofibulargelenk unauffällig.
